reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch distinguish Joshua's defeat of Gezer's king and relief force from actual capture of the city, which Judges later shows remained in Canaanite hands.

sides.snippet: Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
sides.verseText: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

sides.snippet: Ephraim didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer
sides.verseText: Ephraim didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
